Players Committee card image of [[Supreme Leader Snoke (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If you just initiated a battle where all your ability is provided by First Order characters and/or [First Order] starships, opponent loses 1 Force. If just lost, Kylo is power +3 until end of your next turn. Immune to attrition < 8 (< 4 if with Kylo).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/supremeleadersnoke.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 6489b69] (10 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
